notes: Every line carries a destination taken from OP_MODEL_STRUCTURE.md, including the COE names recorded in its addendum. Where the 2026 Budget tab records a platform in squad wording, the structure wording is used here and the budget wording is quoted in the evidence: SAP and PDF Tools sit at Finance / Finance where that tab reads "AU Finance", and the Lytton site work sits at Fuel Infrastructure / Manufacturing where that tab reads "Manufacturing & Group Projects".
A COE destination carries no platform, matching the 2026 Budget tab, where the platform column is empty on every COE line.

Credits follow the product named in column N, which is how the 2026 Budget tab treats every recharge: row 225 "Z Energy Recharge" and row 226 "Cyber Sentinel recharge" sit at TDD / TDD beside the Azure accrual, row 452 "Snowflake recharge" sits at Enterprise Data / Data beside the Snowflake licence, rows 199 and 200 place the ServiceNow recharges at the same COE as the subscription, and rows 262 and 264 place the Atlassian and Adobe user chargebacks at TDD / TDD. The mapping values present in the source file do the same, for example the APPLCCO reallocation lines at sheet rows 4707 to 4771, which stay with that centre's destination.

Cost centre APPLH_INFOTECH carries no mapping values in columns A and B, so no rule here can contradict a mapping value; the 784 pre-existing rows sit in other cost centres and serve here only as evidence of pattern.

The block is a pooled buying centre: 1,044 lines carry a positive value totalling 70,413,797.21, 344 lines carry a negative value totalling 45,103,949.08 and 42 lines carry nil, netting to the block total of 25,309,848.13.
